_comment: Public texts of the task page and the scorecard (site/build.py). `title` and `subtitle` replace task.json's title; `references` and `baselines` describe each design in one sentence (the internal notes of task.json and tests/expected.json are never shown). `score_tips` (optional): the "What moves the score" box, observations from trial runs (Markdown inline, placeholders allowed), never promises.
title: N-bit adder
subtitle: Add two N-bit numbers and a carry in, with logic gates only.

references.add_n: A ripple-carry adder in a generate loop, proved with the sv_comb tactics: the intended way to work.
references.add_proc: The same adder with its carry cell written as an `always_comb` `if`/`else`.
references.add_proc_m: The same adder with the whole bit cell, carry and sum, in one `always_comb` block.
references.add_mux: The same adder written with `~` and the conditional operator `?:`.
references.add_n_byhand: The same design as `add_n`, proved by hand without the tactics: the by-hand proof.

baselines.plus: Yosys's own adder, `assign {cout, s} = a + b + cin;`, which uses the banned `+`.
baselines.add_n_sklansky: A Sklansky parallel-prefix adder, checked by simulation, not proved yet.
baselines.add_n_kogge_stone: A Kogge-Stone parallel-prefix adder, checked by simulation, not proved yet.
baselines.cmp_carry: Every carry computed by a run-time comparison, which Yosys builds as its own adder: banned in this task since 2026-11-05, like `+`.

score_tips: The pinned flow's ABC script restructures what you write: a two-bit lookahead carry came back as the same ripple of NAND gates, and scored worse.

Statement order and gate forms move both area and delay: the carry assign before the sum assign in the loop, and bit 0's carry written as a majority at module level with the loop from `i = 1`, each moved area × time by a few percent. Blank lines and signal or block names changed nothing.
Commuting the operands of one operator moves the A0' area by up to 11% and the delay by up to 32% (the maintainers' measurement, `score/PPA.md`).
`score/ppa.py solution.sv --task tasks/add --no-mapped --path` names the critical path with each net's arrival time: read it before you guess.
